0022600146.text: The Grizzlies (4-0, 3-0 on the road) come into this fifth game of their season 2nd in the Southwest, 0.5 games back, and 3rd in the West, while the Trail Blazers (3-0, 1-0 at home) sit 1st in the Northwest and 2nd in the West. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Portland won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 122-114 win in Memphis on March 4, 2026. For Portland, Chris Youngblood is out with ankle soreness, Shaedon Sharpe is out with a knee injury following surgery, and Robert Williams III is day-to-day with a knee issue and listed as a game-time decision.
